title: The Children of Men
author: P. D. James
summary: In 2021 Britain, humanity has been infertile for twenty-five years, and an authoritarian ruler governs a dying society. Theo, an Oxford historian, is drawn into a small group of dissidents.
readIf: you like quiet, bleak dystopias that focus on society and meaning.
skipIf: you expect the pace and action of the film adaptation.
